Alfresa Holdings Corporation
was founded on September 29, 2003, and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is a major health care holding company that operates
nationwide wholesale networks, manufacturing units, and dispensing pharmacies for ethical pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter self-medication products, medical devices, and regenerative medicine materials

: 2003 (as a joint holding company, with operational historical roots dating back to the 1910s–1930s through predecessors like Fukujin and Azwell)

What the Company Does
: Engages in the wholesale distribution of ethical prescription drugs and self-medication products, manufactures pharmaceuticals and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) via subsidiaries like Alfresa Pharma, manages dispensing pharmacies, and develops regenerative medicine and diagnostic tools.
